IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Tuesday, August 4, 2026**

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** is printing money right now. Three contractors (Cupertino, Gurtz, MJ Electric) are stacking **JW wage plus $10/hr base increase** on Port Washington Data Center work — that's a hard $10 over scale before you clock OT. Pieper's throwing service truck foreman pay at Milwaukee locals. Book's moving fast; 37 calls across 205 hands means you could be working by end of week if you're service-ready.

**LU-481 Indianapolis, IN** is the biggest board play at 32 calls, 153 hands, **$54.75 top scale**. Ermco's got 38 slots on the Google Data Center in Mooresville running 5-10s plus Saturdays — that's incentive pay hidden in the hours. Industrial Electric's Eli Lilly K153 job wants 6-10s Monday through Saturday. This is grind-it-out work, but Book 1's thinning.

**LU-291 Boise, ID** is the dark horse. Prime Controls and Lea Electric are both on Micron ID1, paying **$45.33/hr base plus $20/hr incentive and $170/day per diem** (7 days if eligible) — that's **$65.33 total package** before OT. PLA job, which means ironclad. VECA's META project hits full scale **$65.33** with OT premiums. 16 calls, 106 hands, low book depth.

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** runs hot. 56 calls, 323 hands, but Inglett & Stubbs owns the board with 65 slots across Wellstar Hospital and QTS data centers at **$40/hr**. Cable tray hanging and medium voltage pulling — solid work, Saturdays optional on some calls.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** is stacking incentives. Parsons Electric's Polaris Forge Data Center pays **$44.80 scale plus $100/day M-F, $150 Sat/Sun incentive** (non-taxed) — that's **$164/day** on the side for 6-10s work. 49 calls posted, book's wide open.

The story: data centers and infrastructure are vacuuming up hands nationwide. Milwaukee and Boise are pulling the best rates; Indianapolis and Grand Forks are the volume plays.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Tuesday, August 4, 2026**

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** is running hot with 46 calls and ~140 hands needed. NEW RIVER ELECT. CORP. is your play here—40 JW Lineman on distribution work, Columbus base, **$125/night PD plus $125 bonus on 10-hour days**, 6-10s with a CDL requirement. Their Southern Ohio satellite crew (9 hands) runs 4-10s with optional Fri/Sat. CAPITAL ELECTRIC LINE BUILDERS has 6 more JWs on cable splicing in Johnstown at **$100/day PD**. This board's thick and moving.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** sits at 21 calls, 104 hands needed, and the Polaris Forge Data Center play is huge. Parsons Electric's got 64 Inside JWs at **$44.80/hr with $100 non-taxed daily PD, plus $100 Mon-Fri incentive and $150 Sat/Sun**, another $100/day if you bring an ND license. 6-10s. Hunt Electric on the Air Base runs 4-10s with 8-hour Friday OT at the same scale. Real ID or ND license required.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** shows 9 calls, 79 hands. Summit Line and Cupertino Electric are holding **$55/hr with all OT double time** and NM State JIW License (EE98J) mandatory. Rosendin's slightly cheaper at **$40/hr plus $15 incentive** for 90% of 60-hour weeks.

**LU-175 Chattanooga, TN** has 13 calls. Adman Electric's DNN4 Data Center dominates—25 JWs day shift, 24 night shift at **31.4% shift premium**, both running 7x12s rotating. Day and Zimmermann's nuclear work at Watts Bar (TVA clearance required) is the high-end play.

**LU-291 Boise, ID** offers 18 calls. VECA Electric's running META sites at **$65.33/hr with incentive program OT premium**—the board's top-scale rate here. Micron work through Prime, Quality, and Lea pays **$45.33 with $170/day PD** if eligible (PLA).

Data centers and transmission rebuilds are eating every available hand; board depth is real across the tier-one locals, but the sub-$50 rates are filling slower.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Tuesday, August 4, 2026**

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** is moving fast. Eighteen calls, sixty-one hands needed—BCS Mechanical is hammering the Sego Project in West Valley with dual pushes: fifteen journeyman pipefitters and thirteen journeymen plumbers, all locked into 4-10s starting Aug 3. DSI's got six more fitters on the QTS job in Eagle Mountain running mixed 5-8s and 5-10s with a **$10.00 per diem kicker**. Five apprentice slots open too. This board's burning through labor.

**LU-290 Portland, OR** has twenty-one calls against thirty hands—tightest ratio on the sheet. Intel Ronler Acres is the draw: Charter Mechanical's booking four orbital welders for tool install (Ticket #71459), Apollo's got two BIM detailers at foreman scale on the same campus. PermaCold's pulling three commercial refrig service techs locally. High-skill semiconductor and commercial work.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** sits at twelve calls, forty-eight hands. Nutrien Shutdown is the anchor: Bmwc's running eleven pipefitters on 7-12s with **$11/hr incentive on straight time, $16.50/hr on OT, or $150/day per diem over 50 miles**—must be current in DISA. Graham's Cenovus Maintenance gig adds ten more fitters on 4-10s. Fab shop work mixed in.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** has thirteen calls, thirty-one hands. Apollo's DC2 Data Center in Aurora is the big ticket—eight fitters, 6-10s days, commercial rate plus incentive. US Engineering's Broadcom work in Fort Collins targets high-purity fitters with tube bending chops. Murphy's Corden Pharma gig (Boulder) pays **$125 per diem** outside 100 miles, 2nd shift combo welding.

**LU-525 Las Vegas, NV** is thin but live: one call, twelve hands needed at Four Seasons towers (Henderson), starting Thursday 7/30. OSHA 10/30 mandatory.

Data center build-outs and semiconductor fab tooling are pulling the strongest hands right now—the Arizona-Nevada-Utah-Colorado corridor is eating work.
